title: Stamp Islamabad Capital Territory Amendment Ordinance 1984

sections.shortTitle: Stamp Islamabad Capital Territory Amendment Ordinance 1984
sections.description:
Short title, extent and commencement

ORDINANCE VI OF 1984
ORDINANCE VI OF 1984
STAMP (ISLAMABAD CAPITAL TERRITORY) (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1984
An Ordinance further to amend the Stamp Act, 1899
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 1st February, 1984]
No. F. 17 (1)/84-Pub.--The
following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general
information:-
1. Short title, extent and commencement.---(1) This Ordinance may
be called the Stamp (Islamabad Capital Territory) (Amendment) Ordinance, 1984.
(2) It extends to the Islamabad
Capital Territory.
(3) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.shortTitle: Stamp Islamabad Capital Territory Amendment Ordinance 1984
sections.description:
Amendment of Schedule I, Act II of 1899

ORDINANCE VI OF 1984
ORDINANCE VI OF 1984
STAMP (ISLAMABAD CAPITAL TERRITORY) (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1984
An Ordinance further to amend the Stamp Act, 1899
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 1st February, 1984]
No. F. 17 (1)/84-Pub.--The
following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general
information:-
2. Amendment of Schedule I, Act II of 1899.--In the Stamp Act, 1899
(II of 1899), in Schedule I, after Article 44, the following new Article shall
be inserted, namely:---
"44-A. Participation Term Certificate. The same duty as
is leviable on a Debenture [No. 27 (b)] of the same value."
